_what: Before-snapshot for the owner-approved games-side writes of the estate orphan sweep. THIS FILE IS THE ROLLBACK MATERIAL — this repo has no change_log table, the same reason docs/covers-migration-2026-08-15-*-snapshot.json exist (docs/access/covers-r2.md §0).

_why.dccSeries: Owner-approved. 29 rows (ids 570-598) carried series = NULL while every one of their names begins 'Dungeon Crawler Carl'. Setting the series gives the DCC product line the same grouping 'Dice Throne', 'Catan' and 'Ascension' already have — and it is what lets catalog-platform's new 'Dungeon Crawler Carl' universe reach them with ONE series claim instead of 29 title overrides. Board-game rows join the rest of the estate only at the universe tier (work_fold is null for games by design), so without this the 29 owned DCC products could never appear beside the 14 DCC books.
_why.lotrParent: Owner-approved. Item 665 'The Lord of the Rings Roleplaying' was filed as an EXPANSION of item 621 (Dungeon Master's Guide, 2014). It is a standalone licensed Free League RPG that happens to be 5e-compatible, not a supplement to the D&D core book — the same conflation that makes 'D&D' a rules system rather than a continuity, now recorded as a refusal in catalog-platform data/universes.json _refused. Un-parented to a base item that roots itself. Its series stays 'D&D' (that IS its system), and Middle-earth claims it by exact title override.

_rollback: UPDATE item SET series = NULL, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id IN (570..598); and UPDATE item SET kind='expansion', parent_item_id=621, root_game_id=621, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id=665; The `before` array below is the authoritative prior state for every column touched.
